xi_bounds: IMPLEMENTATION limit: P2.4-A's xi_from_gas fails when H2O or CO goes negative, so usable xi is bounded by the remaining H2O and by F_CO. PHYSICAL supply: P1.13-A line 23 states quench water supplies xi and is NOT limited by outlet H2O, so xi > outlet H2O is a quench-water requirement (P1.13-A P4 marker), not an infeasibility. No upper bound on quench supply is available in this project, so physically_infeasible is left null rather than asserted.
